botanical.summary: Plant a friendly leafy hedge of Bana right beside your baby rice nursery to keep bugs and disease away!
botanical.how: Plant Bana (Vitex negundo) alongside the paddy nursery bed.

botanical.summary: Crush spiky Ramban leaves and drop them right where water enters your paddy field!
botanical.how: Crush fresh Ramban (Agave americana) leaves and place them at the water channel inlet feeding the paddy field.

botanical.summary: A traditional leafy remedy farmers swear by to keep hungry hispa beetles off rice leaves!
botanical.how: Apply ankharein leaves to control rice hispa, following local farmer practice in Kangra and Hamirpur.

local_practice.summary: Store harvested grain in a big spindle-shaped bamboo basket—a cozy, breathable, pest-proof home!
local_practice.how: Store harvested paddy and finger millet grain in large spindle-shaped bamboo baskets, locally called 'Perru'.
